param.title: Param
param.description: Report parameter that provides the value

value.title: Value
value.description: Fixed value; a list for 'in' and [from, to] for 'between'

Filter.title: Filter
Filter.description:
Filter on a dimension. The value comes from a report parameter (`param`) or is fixed
(`value`); exactly one of the two.

sql.title: Sql
sql.description: One aggregate expression in DuckDB dialect over columns of the model's table, e.g. SUM(gross_amount - discount). No subqueries, windows or unknown functions; every column inside an aggregate.

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: Who is accountable for the definition

label.title: Label
label.description: Text for the viewer's control; the name if empty

mode.description: live: every view queries the source. snapshot: each reader's data (with their RLS) is computed once and kept until the report is republished or `refresh_hours` pass

refresh_hours.title: Refresh Hours
refresh_hours.description: snapshot only: hours after which a reader's snapshot is recomputed; empty = until the report is republished

access.title: Access
access.description: Groups allowed to open the report; empty = any authenticated reader

RlsRule.title: RlsRule
RlsRule.description: Row filter for sources without native RLS: column = value of the reader's claim.

source.title: Source
source.description: Id of a registered connection (never credentials)

time_grain.description: Groups a temporal dimension by period (date_trunc)

VisualDraft.title: VisualDraft
VisualDraft.description: What the builder assembles: a Visual without id/title/layout (those come with reports, Phase 6).
